name: @loom/split-hydration
description: loom-ui split hydration for anyone: a weather-station board whose browser never sees a provider. The server compiles the Blueprint and ships a handle inventory (a keyed revision, never a tool or a script); a client SplitHydrationController schedules loads through a JSON HandleLoader; two widgets sharing one upstream reading go out together and are served with ONE upstream call; the server answers with serveHandle/serveHandles — relative-time tokens on an injected clock, overridable station/time-range params, Named reshapers, contract-checked output (an empty alert log is healthy), and report-and-proceed for a read-only viewer.
